warehouse.label: Warehouse
warehouse.empty: There are no warehouses available. Create one before recording movements.

list.createFailed: The document could not be created. Try again.
list.empty: There are no movements of this type yet.

placeholder: This screen ships with its module.

document.pdfFailed: The PDF couldn't be generated. Please try again.
document.confirmBody: {{lines}} lines will be posted and the warehouse stock will change. A confirmed movement can't be edited: fixing it requires recording another one.
document.cancelBody: Number {{folio}} will be voided and never reused. The lines you loaded will be lost.
document.hasErrors: Fix the flagged lines before confirming.
document.emptyLines: No lines yet. Add products or upload a spreadsheet.
document.readOnly: This movement was already confirmed: it's history and can't be edited.
document.notePlaceholder: Why this movement is being recorded
document.confirmedBody: Folio {{folio}} was posted and stock has moved.
document.transferHint: On confirmation the goods leave this warehouse and stay IN TRANSIT: they do not add up at the destination until someone there confirms receipt.
document.receptionHint: This entry was generated by a transfer: the reason and the origin warehouse are set by the transfer and cannot be edited. Adjust the quantities to what actually arrived and confirm.
document.compositeHint: Its components will be deducted, not the composite itself.
document.compositeCeiling: With what is in this warehouse, {{units}} can be assembled.

document_not_draft: This movement is no longer a draft: someone confirmed or voided it. Refresh the screen to see how it ended up.
document_empty: This movement has no lines: add at least one product before confirming.
warehouse_out_of_scope: You don't have access to this warehouse.
warehouse_inactive: This warehouse is inactive: stock can't be moved in it.
reference_required: The reference is missing (document number or purpose).
note_required: An explanation is missing: this reason requires a note.
reason_not_allowed: This reason can't be chosen here.
authorizer_invalid: The authorizing person isn't a user of this business.
quantity_must_be_positive: The quantity must be greater than zero.
quantity_too_many_decimals: Quantities allow at most 4 decimal places.
product_not_found: One of the products doesn't exist.
presentation_invalid: The chosen presentation doesn't belong to this product or is inactive.
integer_only_presentation: The presentation "{{presentationName}}" only accepts whole quantities.
composite_has_no_stock: A composite product has no stock of its own: it's assembled when sold or consumed.
composite_without_composition: This composite product has no components defined.
insufficient_stock: Not enough stock of "{{sku}}": there are {{available}} and {{requested}} were requested.
lot_required: This product is tracked by lot: please indicate which one.
expiry_required: This product is tracked by lot: the lot's expiry date is missing.
lot_not_tracked: This product isn't tracked by lot.
lot_expiry_mismatch: Lot "{{lotCode}}" already exists with a different expiry date.
transfer_same_warehouse: The destination warehouse must be different from the origin.
transfer_entry_requires_transfer: A transfer entry is confirmed from the in-transit transfers view.
transfer_not_in_transit: This transfer was already received or canceled.
transfer_header_locked: The reason and warehouse of a transfer are set by the transfer itself: they cannot be edited from the entry.
transfer_wrong_destination: This transfer isn't headed to this warehouse.
transfer_lines_incomplete: Some transfer line is missing confirmation.
transfer_line_unknown: One of the lines doesn't belong to this transfer.
received_exceeds_sent: You can't receive more than what was sent: {{sent}} were sent and {{received}} are declared.
count_file_too_large: The file is over 5 MB. Please split it into smaller parts.
document_line_not_found: That line doesn't exist in this movement.
import_unreadable: We couldn't read the file. Make sure it's the Excel template.
import_empty: The file has no rows to load.

expiring.title: Expiring soon
expiring.discardFailed: The exit could not be created. Try again.

transfers.title: Transfers in transit
transfers.staleTitle: More than a week in transit: check whether it already arrived.
transfers.receiveBody: A draft Entry will be created with the sent quantities already loaded. There you adjust what actually arrived and confirm it.
transfers.receiveFailed: The entry could not be created. Someone may have already received or canceled it.
transfers.cancelWarning: Stock does NOT return to the origin: the exit already happened and is history. If the goods reappear, record them as an Entry with reason Adjustment.
transfers.cancelReasonPlaceholder: Why this transfer is being canceled
transfers.cancelFailed: It could not be canceled. Refresh the screen to see how it ended up.

count.templateHint: Lot-tracked products get one row per lot and location; leave those columns empty for the rest.
count.uploadHint: Upload the file with the «counted» column filled in. It replaces what was loaded before.
count.freshHint: The count is applied against the balance at approval time, not the current one: if someone sells while you count, it is taken into account.
count.needsManage: An Admin must approve this count. The draft stays saved with its folio, waiting for them.
count.drifted: {{count}} lines changed balance between counting and approval. What was counted has been applied.
count.drifted_one: {{count}} line changed balance between counting and approval. What was counted has been applied.
count.importFailed: The file could not be read. Check that it is the downloaded template.
count.importDoneWithErrors: {{count}} rows could not be read: check them in the list.
count.importNoCounted: {{count}} rows were loaded, but none has a value in «counted». Check that you saved the file in Excel after filling it in, then upload it again.

kardex.title: Kardex
kardex.compositeHint: Composite products have no kardex of their own: they are assembled when consumed. Check their components.
kardex.belowMinTitle: The total is below the minimum of {{min}}.
kardex.inTransitHint: It left one of your warehouses and nobody has confirmed it at the destination yet.
kardex.assemblable: With what is available, {{units}} can be assembled.
kardex.expiryWarning: The expiry date decides which lot is sold first. Changing it means the next exit may take a different batch than it would today.
kardex.saveFailed: The lot could not be saved.
